fogOpacity.name: Fog Opacity
fogOpacity.hint: Opacity of fog layer. By default only for GMs (0 to 1 where 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque). Less Fog module default is 0.75. Value without this module is 1.0.

revealTokens.name: Reveal Tokens
revealTokens.hint: Reveal all tokens on the canvas to the GM at all times.

affectAll.name: Reveal to All Players
affectAll.hint: Reveal Unexplored areas and tokens to all players (useful if you just want to know about line of sight).

gmVisionButton.name: GM Vision Button
gmVisionButton.hint: Add a button to the Token controls that lets the GM toggle the fog of war on and off. Not available in the PF2e system, which provides its own button.
